faults.label: NT1 the GEMM's row tasks stop before the ragged tail (rows past the last whole 64-row task are never computed on a pool)
NT2 the runner's claim stops one task short (the last task of every job never runs on a pool)
NT3 a GEMM task adds its terms without first scaling its elements by beta
NT4 the elementwise kernels' last chunk is dropped (at every thread count, the serial kernel keeps it)
NT5 RMSNorm's last row chunk is dropped
faults.new: rms_job j; unsigned char bytes[BCIR_TENSOR_SCAN_TASKS]; size_t tasks=rows/BCIR_ROW_CHUNK;
faults.old: rms_job j; unsigned char bytes[BCIR_TENSOR_SCAN_TASKS]; size_t tasks=(rows+BCIR_ROW_CHUNK-1)/BCIR_ROW_CHUNK;

faults.label: NT6 RoPE's last position chunk is dropped
NT7 the AdamW commit's last chunk is dropped (the reference update sees it, at one thread)
NT8 the backward's task runs one query head short of its KV head's group (the serial run too: the reference catches it)
NT9 the pair job's second GEMM starts at the first's column count, not its task count (NDT-SCHED-0: the first's last row sets never run, the second's first tasks run twice)
NT10 the pair job's serial path (no pool, one thread) skips the first GEMM (the one-thread pool's state is not the serial state, and the pair is not the two entries)
NT11 a claim takes two tasks (every other task of a job never runs on a pool)
NT12 the caller does not reset the claim counter (a job after the first starts where the last one's claims ended, so its first tasks never run)
NT13 the group job's chain tasks start at its second call (the first chained product never reaches its C on a pool)
NT14 the group job's independent calls start at their own task counts, not the running sum (a later call's tasks are never claimed, an earlier call's only in part)
NT15 a chain whose calls differ in n runs as one chain (task t is a different tile in each call, so the tiles' terms land apart)
NT16 the group's serial path drops its first independent call (one thread, or no pool)
NT17 the grouped backward starts its input-adjoint chain adding (q's and gate's dx onto the arena's stale values; the reference catches it at every thread count)
NT18 the grouped forward drops its last linear (v and up never computed, at every thread count: the reference catches it)
